notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
